title: feat(app-shell,plugin-detail): the author of a record comment can edit and delete it from the record feed (objectui#12268)
body:
Fixes #12268
Clause-②: yes

The record feed now offers the author of a comment Edit and Delete on their own comment and reply. Nobody else is offered either control on it. Triage `6127815908` ruled fork A: `sys_comment` is `managedBy: 'platform'`, which declares the generic Edit / Delete affordances, so the feed honours that declaration and no spec key is added. The `Clause-②: yes` above is the package surface (listed under "Published surface"), not the spec.

## What changes

- **One owner rule.** `isCommentAuthor(authorId, viewerId)` is new in `@object-ui/collaboration`. `CommentThread` now reads it instead of its inline comparison, and the record page asks it for every `sys_comment` row it maps. Two absent or empty ids are no match (the inline comparison read two empty ids as ownership).
- **The host decides authorship, the feed never derives it.** `RecordDetailView` marks each comment row with the new optional `FeedItem.authoredByViewer`, through that rule, and hands `onEditComment` / `onDeleteComment` to the feed through `DiscussionContext`. Each handler is handed over under its own grant on `sys_comment`, through two new rows of the affordance-to-grant map: `feedCommentEdit` (update) and `feedCommentDelete` (delete).
- **The feed.** `RecordActivityTimeline`, and the reply list `ThreadedReplies`, offer Edit and Delete on a `comment` row only when the host marked it the viewer's AND handed over that control's handler. `record:activity` and `record:discussion` (through `RecordChatterPanel`) forward both handlers off the context. A row that offers neither renders the same body paragraph as before.
- **Edit** opens the text in place (Save and Cancel; Escape cancels, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves). The page writes `body`, `mentions` (re-derived from the new text with the composer's `extractMentions`), `is_edited: true` and `edited_at`, and changes the row only after the server answers. A refusal raises a localized error toast; the editor keeps the draft and the row keeps its text.
- **Delete** asks first through the page's own `confirmHandler`, which opens the same `ActionConfirmDialog` the record's own Delete uses, painted destructive (the mechanism objectui#12248 used for attachments). Cancel sends nothing. A refusal raises a localized error and the row stays. A deleted reply takes one off its parent's `replyCount`.
- **Edited mark.** The read maps `is_edited` onto the existing `FeedItem.edited`, so a stored edit reads as edited after a reload. A reply now shows the mark too.
- Five `detail.*` keys in all ten packs; docs in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`; changeset `.changeset/12268-feed-comment-edit-delete.md` (minor for every touched published package; no `major`).

## Measurements (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

1. **The server stamps neither `is_edited` nor `edited_at`.** On objectstack `origin/main` `c5b43b60`, `git grep -c` over the whole tree finds `is_edited` and `edited_at` only in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts` (the field declarations) and four generated translation files. `comment-access-hooks.ts` has zero hits for either; control: the string "authors govern their own words" hits that file once. Its `beforeUpdate` authorizes (the author, or a user who can edit the parent record) and writes nothing. So the ruling's other branch applies: the client that makes the edit records it, and the next read shows the mark from the row itself.
2. **The feed item did not carry the author id.** `FeedItem` has `actor` (a display name) and no id, and the page's `sys_comment` read dropped `author_id`. The route below never sends an id to the feed: the host answers ownership per row.
3. **The route for one owner rule.** Both suggested routes were measured. (a) A predicate in a package both depend on: `plugin-detail` and `collaboration` share only `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/i18n`, neither of which carries behaviour, so (a) costs a new dependency edge or a logic export from the types package. (b) The host decides per row: `app-shell` already imports `@object-ui/collaboration` (presence), so `RecordDetailView` reads the exported rule with no new module edge, and the feed reads one boolean. Chosen: (b). It adds one export to collaboration and one optional data member to `FeedItem`, and the feed gains no dependency. `CommentThread` reads the same export, so there is still exactly one rule.
4. **Published surface:** below, read off the built declarations.
5. **The confirm:** `RecordDetailView` already mounts `ActionConfirmDialog` behind its promise-based `confirmHandler` (the record Delete's, objectui#11001). The comment delete calls that handler: no new confirm component and no second dialog mount.

Where the measured route left the suggested one: the `sys_comment` text field is `body`, not `content`. And the feed's `sys_comment` read does not re-run on the invalidation bus (its effect keys on the record, the reaction store and the user), so, as `handleAddComment` / `handleAddReply` already do, the page writes the server-confirmed result into its own per-record feed slice once the write answers. No remount and no `key=` bump (AGENTS.md rule 8).

## Published surface

Generic arguments are spelled in words (`PROMISE of void`) because GitHub strips angle-bracket fragments from PR bodies.

- `@object-ui/collaboration` (entry `dist/index.d.ts`): new function `isCommentAuthor(authorId: string | null | undefined, viewerId: string | null | undefined): boolean`.
- `@object-ui/types`, `FeedItem`: new member `authoredByViewer?: boolean`.
- `@object-ui/react`, `DiscussionContextValue` (and so `DiscussionContextProviderProps`): new members `onEditComment?: (itemId: string | number, text: string) => void | PROMISE of void` and `onDeleteComment?: (itemId: string | number) => void | PROMISE of void`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: the same two members, with the same types, on `RecordActivityTimelineProps`, `RecordChatterPanelProps` and `ThreadedRepliesProps`. `CommentBody` / `CommentBodyProps` in the new `CommentAuthorControls` module are not re-exported from the entry, and the package's `exports` map names `.` only.
- `@object-ui/core`, `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS`: new rows `feedCommentEdit: { crud: 'edit', grant: 'update' }` and `feedCommentDelete: { crud: 'delete', grant: 'delete' }`, so `ConsoleAffordance` gains those two names. No exhaustive map over `ConsoleAffordance` exists outside core's own mapped type.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `detail.editComment`, `detail.deleteComment`, `detail.deleteCommentConfirm`, `detail.commentEditFailed`, `detail.commentDeleteFailed`, in all ten packs.

Every member is new and optional; no existing member's type changed.

## Tests (round 0 at head `50c82f9`; patch round 1 at `258bfee` below)

New pins:
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordActivityTimeline.authorControls-12268.test.tsx` (13): controls only on a comment row the host marked the viewer's and only with the handler; edit, refusal, empty/unchanged draft, Cancel/Escape; delete; edited mark on a row and a reply; a reply's own controls; both feed blocks forward the context's handlers.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedCommentEditDelete-12268.test.tsx` (19), through the real `RecordDetailView` under a real `I18nProvider` and `MePermissionsProvider`, for both `record:activity` (HotCRM's case-page shape) and `record:discussion`: the author sees both controls on their own comment and neither on another's; the page asks `isCommentAuthor` per row; another member sees them on their own comments and not on the author's; a stored `is_edited` reads as edited; the edit writes `body` / `is_edited` / `edited_at` / `mentions` and then reads as edited; a refused edit raises the error and keeps the text; delete through the real `ActionConfirmDialog` (Cancel sends nothing, Delete deletes); a refused delete raises the error and keeps the row; each control under its own grant.
- `packages/collaboration/src/__tests__/comment-authorship-12268.test.tsx` (4): the rule's truth table, and `CommentThread` calls it.
- Updated: `packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (the two rows in `EXPECTED_GRANT`, and `WRITE_SITES` entries for `handleEditComment` / `handleDeleteComment`).

- Declared narrowing: the rest of app-shell's test files and of core / types are CI's. The grep selection is blind to a test that reaches `RecordDetailView` without naming it (for example through console routes).

Type-check (script `type-check`, name echoed per package): types, react, core, collaboration, plugin-detail, app-shell, plugin-form, i18n joined with `&&`, exit 0. Downstream (consumer direction) of the widened symbols, selected by grepping the symbols: fields, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-grid, plugin-kanban, plugin-list, plugin-timeline, plugin-view and apps/console, all `Done`. Reverse check: handing `onEditComment` a `(id: boolean, text: number)` function in `RecordDetailView` turned `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` red with TS2322 against `(itemId: string | number, text: string) => void | PROMISE of void`, so app-shell reads the rebuilt type; restored to the HEAD blob.

Ablations, each through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit exactly once, blob changed on disk, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). The subjects resolve to `src` through the vitest alias map, so no build sits between legs:

| Leg | Mutation | Pins |
|---|---|---|
| A1b | the page compares `c.author_id === currentUser.id` inline (a second owner rule) | host: 2 failed / 17 passed (the "asks the one rule" case, both blocks) |
| A1 | the page marks no row `authoredByViewer` | host: 16 failed / 3 passed |
| A2 | the read drops the `is_edited` mapping | host: 2 failed / 17 passed |

The first A4 attempt was refused by the tool itself (the replacement text was already present once), so it measured nothing; it was re-run in `--delete` mode, the row above.

Patch round 1 (seat REWORK `6129134468`):

- Patch round 1, head `258bfee`: `RecordActivityTimeline.authorControls-12268.test.tsx` +3 (with threading on, a reply whose parent the feed does not hold is a root row between the rows it sits between in time; CONTROL: with its parent held the same reply nests behind the toggle; the viewer's orphaned reply keeps its Edit and Delete). `RecordDetailView.feedCommentEditDelete-12268.test.tsx` +2, one per block (`record:activity`, `record:discussion`): Ada deletes her comment carrying Grace's reply through the real confirm; Grace's reply stays as a row of its own with no toggle and no controls for Ada, and stays on a fresh mount whose `sys_comment` read returns the stored rows, the orphan among them (the fake server, like the real one, keeps replies on delete).
- Ablation A7 (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `rootItems` back to `!i.parentId`): `Tests 4 failed | 33 passed (37)` across the two files (both host cases, two timeline cases); restore blob == HEAD (`6728eef7a2a4`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Runs at `258bfee`, through the verify lock: plugin-detail's whole suite in two halves, `Test Files 132 passed (132)` / `Tests 955 passed | 6 skipped (961)` and `Test Files 131 passed | 1 skipped (132)` / `Tests 1595 passed | 8 skipped (1603)`; the same 151 grep-selected files as before, `76 passed (76)` / `1089 passed` and `75 passed (75)` / `795 passed`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0; eslint on the 3 touched files 0 errors, warnings unchanged from `50c82f9`; `check:eager-closure` exit 0 (3131.2 KB, headroom 73.3 KB, console rebuilt at `258bfee`).

The eager-closure gates read a console bundle built at `029d951`; the one later commit removes an `export` keyword from a module-private function.

The two new source files have 0 warnings; the new tests carry `as any` warnings like their neighbours. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **No server stamp.** plugin-audit stamps neither `is_edited` nor `edited_at`, so an edit through the data API (not this console) leaves the comment reading unedited, and any client may send `is_edited: false`. A `beforeUpdate` stamp in objectstack (set both when `body` changes) would make the mark trustworthy; once it exists, this client stamp should go (the ruling's first branch). Inferred from source, not measured through a public door, so not filed. Carrier: the next objectstack change to `comment-access-hooks.ts`.
- **The boundary of the owner rule.** The server also lets a parent-record editor update or delete any comment. The feed offers the controls to the author only, as ruled.
- **Deleting a commented-on comment.** The server deletes only that row and keeps its replies, whose `parent_id` then names no row. With threading on, the feed now nests a reply only when it holds the reply's parent; a reply whose parent the feed does not hold is a root row in its place (`rootItems` in `RecordActivityTimeline`), so another member's reply stays on the page, at once and after the feed is read again. The same rule shows a reply whose parent lies before the loaded page as a row of its own until "Load more" brings the parent in; before, such a reply was hidden. The client cascades nothing and adds no rule about which comments may be deleted: that stays the server's call.
- **Mentions on edit.** The mention notification fires on insert only (plugin-audit), so a mention added by an edit notifies nobody; `mentions` is still rewritten so the row's list matches its text.
- **The stale comment the seat noted on objectui#12249** (the old `platform-objects` path and `reactions` in the `sys_comment` read's field list) sits in lines this change edits; it now names `sys_comment` in `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, lists `is_edited` / `edited_at`, and scopes `reactions` to the column store.
- `canStoreReaction`'s docblock in `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` still says reactions are stored in `sys_comment.reactions`; untouched here. Carrier: the next change to the reaction path.
- **Deviation:** one 16-second verbose listing run of the three new pin files ran outside the verify lock.
